source: English translation extracted and cleaned from the user-supplied bilingual Hizbul-Azam PDF

items.text: O Allah, our Rabb and the Rabb of all things, I bear witness that

Hadhrat Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger. O Allah, our Rabb and the Rabb of all things, I bear witness that all Your slaves are brothers. O Allah, our Rabb and the Rabb of all things, Make me and my family sincere in our devotion to You for every moment in this world and in the hereafter. O The
Majestic,
The Benevolent, hear my dua and please accept it. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest of all
Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest of all
Allah is enough for me and what an excellent Supporter He is. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest of all

21. O Allah, correct my Deeni affairs which is in fact a protection for all my affairs, rectify my worldly life which is a source of my survival, rectify for me the life of the hereafter to which I have to return. Keep me alive as long as life is good for me and take me away from this world when death is in my best interest. Make my life a means of doing more
Good, and make my death a tranquillity against all troubles
22. O Allah, I beg You for Halaal (pure) sustenance, beneficial knowledge and deeds that are accepted
23. O Allah, You have satiated us (with food and drink) so make it wholesome for us and You have granted us sustenance which You have made abundant and pure, so (please) increase it. For us

24. O Allah, make me content with what ever You have provided for me and give me barakah (blessings) in it and be a Protector on behalf of me over which are not in front of me (i.e. my family and wealth)
references: 22. Mu’jamus Sagheer # 152 ; 23. Musannaf ibn Abi Shaybah # 24513 ; 24. Mustadrak # 1878

items.text: 25. O Allah, forgive me and have mercy on me. Verily You are the most dignified and honoured

26. O Allah, expand my chest and make my work easy for me. I seek Your protection from the whispers of the heart, from my affairs becoming complicated and having to face difficulties in the grave. O Allah, I seek Your protection from any calamity occurring at night, any calamity occurring during the day and from calamities that fly with the wind
references: 25. Musannaf ibn Abi Shaybah # 15565 ; 26. Musannaf ibn Abi Shaybah # 15135

items.text: 27. O Allah guide me with (divine) guidance, cleanse me with taqwa (piety) and forgive me in this life and the hereafter
28. O Allah, I beg You for beneficial knowledge, abundant sustenance and cure from all illnesses
29. O Allah, You are the strength of my arms and my True Helper. I charge and fight the enemy with Your help and strength and I have no ability to do good actions or avoid evil except with Your help
30. O Allah, all praise is due to You. None can restrict what
You expand and none can expand what You have restricted. None can guide whom
You have caused to fall into error and none can mislead whom You have guided. None can bestow what
You prevent, and none can prevent what You bestow. None can bring near what
You have distanced, and none can distance what You have brought near. O Allah, grant us in abudance
Your blessings, Your mercy, Your grace and Your sustenance

O Allah, I beg of You to grant me Your everlasting favours which never ends nor is taken away. O Allah, I beg of You to grant me safety on the fearful Day (of Judgment). O Allah, I ask You for protection against the evil of what
You have given us and the evil of what You have not given us. O Allah, enable us to love

Imaan and beautify our hearts with it and make us hate kufr (disbelief), immorality and sin and include us among the pious. O Allah, cause us to die as Muslims and join us with the pious, not amongst those who were put to shame nor from those who were tested
O Allah, fight the disbelievers, those who deny Your Messengers and prevent people from treading Your path. Inflict on them
Your severity and punishment, O The True Deity! Aameen
31. O Allah, The Being Who revealed the Book, The One who moves the clouds and The One who causes defeat to the enemy troops, do defeat the disbelievers and enable us to overcome them
32. O Allah, we place You in front of us when fighting them and seek Your protection against their evil plots
33. O Allah, I am hopeful of Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye and ease all my affairs. There is no deity besides
34. O The Everlasting and The Sustainer, persistently do I beg Your mercy
35. O Allah, I am Your slave, the son of Your slave the son of
Your slave woman, my forelock is in Your control, Your decree will definitely prevail over me which is full of justice

I beg of You by whatever names You have given to Yourself, or You have revealed in Your Book, or which You have taught to any one of Your creation, or which You have preserved within Your knowledge, that You make the Holy Qur-aan a source of delight to my heart, the light of my eyes and the healer of my sorrow and my worry and a source of removing my worries
36. O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy. And You convert difficulties into ease if you so desire
37. There is no deity besides Allah, The Most Tolerant and generous, who is free from any fault and
The Rabb of the Great Throne (Arsh)
Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher of the worlds. I ask You for all those things that will make your mercy necessary on me, and all those things that will secure for me

Your forgiveness. (I ask for) safety from sin, and desire a full share of virtuous deeds and complete safety from vice. (O Allah) let not a single sin of mine be left without it being forgiven, nor let any worry or pain be left from being relieved, nor let any grief be left from being dispelled, nor let any difficulty be left from being removed and nor any need of mine which you will be pleased with let it not be left from being fulfilled
O The Most Merciful and Compassionate
1. O Allah, have Mercy on me by allowing me to leave out sins for the rest of my life and have mercy on me by preventing me from falling into matters that do not concern me
And bless me with the ability of recognising those things that will make You happy with me
O Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, Majestic and
Kind, Possessor of dignity which cannot be imagined by anyone else, I beg of You, O Allah,

O The Compassionate One, by the Majesty and the Noor of Your Countenance, that You grant my heart the capacity to memorise Your Book just as You had blessed me with its knowledge and allow me to recite it in a manner that is pleasing to You. O Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, Majestic and Kind,

Possessor of dignity which cannot be imagined by anyone else, I beg of You, O Allah O The Compassionate One, by the Majesty and the noor of Your countenance, that You illuminate my eyes with the noor of Your Book (The Qur-aan), allow its recitation to flow from my tongue, and remove the grief of my heart through it, expand my chest and make my body act in accordance to it, for verily it is only You that can help me realise the truth, and no one else can bless me with this. There is no power to do good or ability to refrain from evil except with the help of Allah, the Most High, The Great
2. O Allah, I make taubah (repent) before You from all sins and
I promise never to return to them ever
3. O Allah, Your forgiveness is much more vast than my sins, and
I am much more hopeful of Your Mercy than my (good) deeds
4. O Allah You are the most Forgiving and You love to forgive so please forgive me

5. O Allah, provide me with halaal rizq (sustenance) that is sufficient to fulfil my needs rather than haraam (forbidden) wealth. And with Your grace make me independent from (asking anything from anyone) besides Yourself
6. O Allah, the Remover of worry and grief, The One who answers the duas of helpless people, the Giver of mercy and grace in this world and the Hereafter
You alone can have mercy on me so favour me in a way that I may no longer be in need of the sympathy of others

7. O Allah, the Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, The Knower of the unseen and the visible, I firmly declare in this world before You that I bear witness that there is no deity besides You . You are One and there is no partner for You and that Hadhrat Muhammad is
Your servant and Messenger. Hence do not entrust me to myself for verily if You entrust me to myself, I will be drawn closer to evil and thrown far away from goodness. I place my full trust in
Your Mercy, hence grant me a promise, to be fulfilled on the
Day of Qiyaamah, (that You will be merciful towards me). Verily You do not break Your promise
8. I beg forgiveness from Allah, The Being besides whom there is no deity. The Everlasting,
The Sustainer. I turn to Him for repentance
9. O Allah! Forgive my sins and accept my repentance. Verily, You are Most Forgiving,
Most Merciful
10. O Allah, I seek Your protection from lethargy, laziness, cowardice, evil old age, having to pay undue penalties and sins
O Allah, I seek Your protection from the punishment of the fire, the torture of the fire, the trials and punishment in the grave and from being tested by an evil kind of test in wealth
10. Al-Hisnul Azam Pg. 315 and an evil kind of test in poverty
11. I seek Your protection from hard heartedness, carelessness, extreme poverty, disgrace and destitution. I seek Your protection from poverty,
(kufr) disbelief, transgression, stubbornness, and showing off
I seek Your protection from deafness, dumbness, leprosy, insanity, and other evil diseases
12. O Allah, I seek refuge in You with Your Greatness beside whom there is no other deity from being led astray by You. You are alive The Being that does not die. Jinn and men are prone to die
13. O Allah, I seek Your protection from severe trials, unfortunate disasters, evil decrees and the ridicule of the enemies
14. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the evil of what I know and the evil of what I do not know
14. Ihyaa Pg. 291
15. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the evil of what I have done as well as what I have not done

16. O Allah, I seek Your protection from being deprived of Your favours, and that your aafiyat (complete protection) turns away from me and from sudden calamities striking me and from all those things that will bring Your wrath
17. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the evil of my ears, the evil of my eyes, my tongue, my heart and my semen

18. O Allah, I seek Your protection from being buried under the debris of a building and I seek Your protection from falling down from the roof of a building, from being drowned in water and from being burnt, and from the despicable old age and I seek Your protection to be saved from the whispers of shaytaan at the time of death, and I seek Your protection from being killed in jihaad with my back towards the enemy (i.e., while I am fleeing from the battlefield). And I seek Your protection from death caused by the biting of a venomous animal
19. O Allah, I seek Your protection from bad manners, evil actions, evil desires and dreadful diseases
20. O Allah, I beg of You (to bless me) with all the good things which
Nabi asked of You and I seek Your protection from all the evil things which Nabi sought protection from

You are the only Being from whom help is sought . Upon You is the fulfilment of our needs and there is no power to do good deeds nor any strength to avoid evil except with the help of Allah who is Most High and The Greatest
21. O Allah, I seek Your protection from a bad neighbour in my locality as neighbours on a journey eventually go their own way
(I seek protection) from hunger as it is an evil companion and from dishonesty as it is an evil quality
22. O Allah, I seek Your protection from useless knowledge, from a heart which does not fear You, from a dua which is not answered by You, from insatiable desires and from all the four said evils
23. O Allah, we seek Your protection from turning back on our heels (turning away from Imaan) or that our Imaan should ever be put to test
24. O Allah, I seek Your protection from an evil day, an evil night, an evil hour, an evil companion and a bad neighbour in my locality
25. O Allah, I seek Your protection from causing disunity, from hypocrisy and from bad manners
25. Abu Dawood 1546
26. O Allah, forgive my sins whether committed deliberately or unintentionally, jokingly or mistakenly or intentionally. And I am responsible for all these sins
27. O Allah, the controller of hearts, turn my heart towards
Your obedience
28. O Allah, I beg of You for correct guidance, piety, chastity and freedom from being needy towards others

29. O Allah, help me and do not help anyone against me. Assist me and do not assist (my enemy) to get the better of me. Plan in support of me and do not plan against me, guide me and make it easy for me to pursue the path of guidance and help me in the event of an enemy rising up against me. O Allah, Make me remember You intensely and make me extremely grateful to You

Make me fear and obey You thoroughly and make me one who pleads with You greatly and turns to You with constant tears and devotion. O Allah, accept my repentance, wash away my sins, accept my duas, strengthen my case, straighten my tongue, guide my heart and remove malice from it
30. O Allah, forgive us, have mercy on us, be pleased with us, accept our actions, admit us in to Jannah, save us from the Fire of Jahannam and get right for us all our affairs

31. O Allah, I beg of You steadfastness in all my affairs, determination to follow the path of virtue, gratitude for Your gifts and the ability to worship You well. I beg of You for a tongue that is truthful, a heart that is sound and an upright conduct

I seek Your protection from the evil of those things which You know and I beg of You for the good of what You know. I beg Your forgiveness for my sins which are known to You. Verily You are fully aware of all hidden things
32. O Allah, unite our hearts and put right for us our mutual affairs
